annotations.title: 集客ファネルの詰まり診断 / Funnel bottleneck diagnosis

description: Diagnose conversion bottlenecks using 2–10 named stage counts and an optional relative improvement percentage. Returns conversion rates, the lowest-rate transition, ranked final-stage gains and data cautions. 集客の改善候補を選ぶために段の名前・人数と改善率を入力し、通過率・最低の段・最後の人数の増分・注意点を返します。 Set language to 'en' for English output.

improvement_percent.description: Relative improvement percentage, 1–100; 10 means a 10% relative increase. / 相対改善率（1〜100）。10は現在の率を相対で10%改善。

language.description: Output language: ja (default) or en. / 出力言語。既定は日本語（ja）、英語はen。

stages.description: Ordered funnel stages. / 上流から順に並べた段。

count.description: Stage population, an integer from 0 to 1,000,000,000. / 段の人数。0〜10億の整数。

name.description: Stage name: 1–40 Unicode characters, not whitespace-only; no Cc, Cf, Zl or Zp characters. / 段名は1〜40文字。空白のみ、制御・書式・行区切り・段落区切り文字は不可。

name: diagnose_funnel_bottleneck

from.description: Previous stage name. / 前の段名。

rate_percent.description: Conversion percentage; 10 means 10%. Can exceed 100 when a stage has more people than the previous one. Null means unavailable. / 通過率の百分率。10は10%。前の段より人数が多い時は100を超えます。算出不可はnull。

to.description: Next stage name. / 次の段名。

bottleneck.description: Lowest-rate transition; earliest on ties, null if unavailable. / 最低通過率の段。同率は先の段。算出不可はnull。

improvement_percent.description: Relative improvement percentage used. / 試算に使った相対改善率。

improvements.description: Independent improvement scenarios ranked by gain or reduction. / 増分または減少数の大きい順の独立した改善試算。

additional_final_count.description: Expected additional final-stage count, or null. / 最後の人数の増分の期待値。算出不可はnull。

from.description: Previous stage name. / 前の段名。

improved_rate_percent.description: Improved percentage, 0–100; 10 means 10%. Null means unavailable. / 改善後の0〜100の百分率。10は10%。算出不可はnull。

projected_final_count.description: Expected final-stage count after improvement, or null. / 改善後の最後の人数の期待値。算出不可はnull。

to.description: Next stage name. / 次の段名。

summary.description: Calculation assumptions and interpretation. / 計算の前提と結果の説明。

transitions.description: Conversion rates between adjacent stages. / 隣接する段の通過率。

from.description: Previous stage name. / 前の段名。

rate_percent.description: Conversion percentage; 10 means 10%. Can exceed 100 when a stage has more people than the previous one. Null means unavailable. / 通過率の百分率。10は10%。前の段より人数が多い時は100を超えます。算出不可はnull。

to.description: Next stage name. / 次の段名。

warnings.description: Data cautions and general reference thresholds. / データの注意点と一般的な目安。
